1. GETRANGE

https://redis.io/docs/latest/commands/getrange/

```text
GETRANGE key start end
```

- Returns a substring of a string value using start and end indexes.
- Indexes are zero-based; negative indexes count from the end.
- The end index is inclusive.


2. SETRANGE

https://redis.io/docs/latest/commands/setrange/

```text
SETRANGE key offset value
```

- Overwrites part of a string value starting at the specified offset.
- If the key does not exist, Redis creates it.
- If the offset is beyond the current string length, Redis fills the gap with null bytes.
- Returns the new string length.
SET string "Today is a good day!"
